      #   x if y.z.nil?

            first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node) ||
            rescue?(node) ||
            allowed_pin_operator?(node) ||
            allowed_expression?(node)

          end

        end

          node.parent&.keyword?
        end

            parentheses?(args.first)
          else
            args.empty? || parentheses?(node)
          end

        PATTERN

          empty_parentheses?(node) ||
            first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node) ||
            rescue?(node) ||
            allowed_pin_operator?(node) ||
            allowed_expression?(node) ||
            do_block_parentheses_required?(node)
        end

        def do_block_parentheses_required?(node)
          node.each_descendant(:block).any? do |block|
            !block.braces? && free_do_block?(block, node)
          end && enclosing_unparenthesized_call(node)
        end

        def free_do_block?(block, boundary)
          current = block
          while (parent = current.parent) && parent != boundary
            return false unless parent.send_type? && parent.receiver.equal?(current)

            current = parent
          end
          true
        end

        def enclosing_unparenthesized_call(node)
          current = node
          loop do
            parent = current.parent
            return unless parent

            case parent.type
            when :send, :csend, :super, :yield
              return parent if parent.arguments.any? { |argument| argument.equal?(current) }
              return unless parent.respond_to?(:receiver) && parent.receiver.equal?(current)

              current = parent
            when :pair
              current = parent
            when :hash
              return if parent.loc.begin

              current = parent
            else
              return
            end
          end
        end
